title: J85 HIPAA end-to-end PHI workflow Journey Object

_meta.purpose: Yejin handles a patient case in a HIPAA-eligible cell with BAA-covered providers and no PHI crossing the BAA boundary.
_meta.data_class_policy: Every persisted property must map to tenant_id and data_class in implementation.

tenant_id.description: Tenant-scoped identifier carrying ADR-0244 universal tenant context.

subject_id.description: Data subject or regulated actor identifier after identity resolution.

pack_overlay.description: Active compliance pack overlay for this journey.

jurisdiction_code.description: Jurisdiction code used by pack activation and cell-placement gates.

locale.description: Locale used for user-visible notices and regulator receipts.

rights_or_obligations.description: Regulatory articles or operational obligations activated by this journey.

microservices.description: Flat microservice roster touched by this journey.

cedar_decision_id.description: Identifier of the Cedar decision that permitted or denied the current step.

audit_seal_ref.description: ADR-0263 audit-chain seal reference for the latest state transition.

provider_byok_ref.description: Reference to tenant provider credential delegation, not an encryption key.

encryption_byok_ref.description: Reference to tenant encryption key material or wrapping key, not provider credentials.

deadline_at.description: Regulator or user-facing deadline in RFC3339 form.

status.description: Current lifecycle state for the journey object.
